description: This file declares the MainThread class and its factory, which implement the IMainThread interface for managing a main thread that handles task queuing and client registration in the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures related to thread management and task handling.

classes.name: MainThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing the singleton instance of MainThread.

classes.name: MainThread
classes.description: Implements the IMainThread interface, managing task execution and client registration within a dedicated thread.

methods.name: MainThreadFactory::getMainThread
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton MainThread instance.

methods.name: MainThread::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client and returns its client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client based on its client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task for a specific client.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task and waits for its completion.

methods.name: MainThread::mainThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop that processes queued tasks.

methods.name: MainThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Waits for and retrieves the next task from the queue.
